Ganesh Mandap Organisers To Register For Online Permissions

Organisers of Ganesh Mandaps in Nashik have been instructed to register for permissions online. This new system aims to streamline the process, eliminating the need for multiple visits to government offices. The initiative is part of efforts to digitize administrative procedures for public events.
